g.title: LOOPGAIN
g.text: ※ This loop is not the amplifier
removing it moves the drug-effect multiple 2.89 → 2.91
it sets only the absolute level of stool water
(refutation of the author's hypothesis — analysis D)

g.text: it does not carry the drug effect

g.text: The real amplifier is the anorectal term

g.title: SI_INVAR
g.text: Dose reduction fixes CYP3A4 but cannot fix P-gp
all it loses instead is efficacy, SBM 4.30 → 3.11

g.title: SBM->RESCUE
g.text: triggered after 72 h without a movement

g.title: NONADH->OP_DOSE
g.text: the patient gives up analgesia themselves
